rows.OD1: | OD1 — Source/domain admission | `Sequence::plan`, `FrameBindings`, projection before `stage::start` | What exact valid binding/domain/alias/schema judgments apply? Which local duty registry identities may be projected, including discharge-only incoming duties and await/R7 boundaries? Current predicates are not silently weakened. Supply exact admission ordering and supported domain; ordinary SC2 projection is not an admission proof. |
rows.OD2: | OD2 — Identity and predecessor carrier | Catalog's existing Program/Plan hashes, invocation ordinals, any future persisted Sequence | Existing stage identities are preserved verbatim. Specify any new source/plan/manifest/whole-prefix identity, canonical preimage, verification, origin, reopen and persistent parent rules. Local labels/array indices are only observations. No new sequence hash, proof lineage or authenticity follows from this design. |
rows.OD3: | OD3 — Errors and publication | `SequenceError`, failures during planning/stage calls/projection/lift/checked totals/export | Specify variants, exact public wire, diagnostic precedence, mutation/publication points and retained earlier observations/work. Existing original StageRejection envelopes/counters must remain available under their current contract; how a new envelope carries them is not defined by this ordinary author. No fabricated zero-attempt result or silent truncation is proposed. |
rows.OD4: | OD4 — Global resource envelope | `LogicalAllocation`, cumulative attempted/committed/remaining observations, output tables | Decide global preflight/enforcement, false/rejected/late-call charges, overflow, invocation/plan/output limits, adapter overhead and closure-reserve use. Existing per-action caps are not raised or borrowed. The proposed positive-trace equations are descriptive arithmetic, not adequacy or lifecycle enforcement evidence. Native DUST/service/proof/wall-time/resource controls retain their owners and historical counters. |
rows.OD5: | OD5 — Participant authority, consent and effects | Whole head/duty creation, source inputs, events, any authenticated successor | Supply required participant/source/intent authority and consent semantics. A shared key, transfer, ordinary local outcome or reviewer decision supplies no such authority. The product remains permissionless; project membership is not a source-language validity argument. |
rows.OD6: | OD6 — Head/ledger/phase semantics | Future native `Step`, failed Q after completed P, reserved/recovery paths | Specify actual phase-dependent effects, consumption, rejection/recovery and native/ledger correspondence. Ordinary local prefix retention does not decide transaction phase atomicity, rollback, ledger uniqueness or proof induction. |
rows.OD7: | OD7 — Private/persistent handoff and asynchronous evidence | Any reopened continuation, external callback or another process/party | Specify permitted witness/artifact ownership, disclosure, availability, origin/correlation/finality/consumption, late results and recovery. The proposed one-process raw StageEvent flow retains current local labels and is not an authenticated asynchronous outcome or isolated private handoff. |
rows.OD8: | OD8 — Other operators | Shared-state schedule, split/join, atomic domain and external asynchronous branches | Supply each operator's actual rule and designated-owner judgments. This sequence has one active action and one local predecessor; it cannot accept a many-parent Join or concurrent head by merely listing it as the next invocation. Existing D1–D5/RV1–RV3 and unadopted SI1–SI4 are not modified. |
